# Pesher Habakkuk Column 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** Well preserved; contains famous Hab 2:3-4 passage

---

**8:1** "And-when it-says, 'so-that the-one-who-reads-it may-run' (Hab 2:2b) —

**8:2** its pesher concerns the-Teacher-of-Righteousness, to-whom God

**8:3** made-known all the-mysteries-of the-words-of His-servants the-prophets.

**8:4** 'For the-vision is-yet for-an-appointed-time;

**8:5** it-testifies-of the-end and-does-not lie' (Hab 2:3a).

**8:6** Its pesher: the-final age will-be-prolonged

**8:7** and-will-exceed all that the-prophets said,

**8:8** for the-mysteries-of God are wonderful.

**8:9** 'If it-tarries, wait for-it; for-it-will-surely

**8:10** come and-will-not delay' (Hab 2:3b).

**8:11** Its pesher concerns the-men-of truth,

**8:12** the-doers-of the-Torah, whose-hands do-not grow-slack

**8:13** from-the-service-of truth, even-when the-final age is-prolonged for-them.

**8:14** For all the-appointed-times-of God will-come in-their-due-course,

**8:15** as He-decreed for-them in-the-mysteries-of His-prudence.

**8:16** 'Behold, the-one-whose-soul is-not upright in-him — but-the-righteous

**8:17** shall-live by-his-faith' (Hab 2:4). Its pesher concerns all who-observe the-Torah in-the-House-of-Judah, whom God will-deliver from-the-house-of-judgment because-of their-suffering and-their-faith in-the-Teacher-of-Righteousness.

---
*EMET notes: Column 8 covers Hab 2:2-4. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
